sentence: This project builds a network of researchers who study how mechanical and computational systems work together in robotics and neuroscience.
This project builds deep learning methods that use protein sequences, structures and interaction data to predict what proteins do.
This project studies how organic aerosols go through oxidation under different conditions, using a flow reactor and mass spectrometry.
This project builds computer models that estimate how much carbon dioxide streams, rivers, lakes and reservoirs release into the atmosphere.
This project builds a knowledge graph that links chemical health and safety data from many separate databases.
This project designs single-molecule magnets that combine bismuth with lanthanides.
This project sets up a confocal microscope system that images living biological samples over time in fine detail.
This project builds computer tools that analyze gene activity in single cells from many kinds of plants.
This project designs a framework that combines deep-learning models with human intelligence to handle input programs better.
This project develops algorithms that find patterns in large datasets and give results that can be trusted.
This project builds a neural operator that learns how to design lightweight structures by using the rules of engineering optimization.
This project supports a symposium where researchers share work on inverse problems, which find the cause of measured effects.
This project builds a sensor that uses electrochemistry to detect a plant hormone called abscisic acid.
This project builds and tests a garment with an adaptive splint that helps clinicians respond to self-injurious behavior.
This project builds a machine learning tool that helps people choose and explore flow surfaces, and applies it to cardiovascular flow.
This project studies symmetries in dynamical systems and geometry, and tries to classify actions of groups on them.
